summary: Bulk Pause via Product Master (/inventory-actions) verified end-to-end. Backend 5/5 pytest pass. Frontend loads, sidebar link nav-inventory-actions works, page renders. BUG-1 (dropdown visibility) FIXED: account-select bg=rgb(39,52,73) dark, color=rgb(241,245,249) light — good contrast. BUG-2 (multi-select colors) FIXED: 2 color chips rendered (Black,Blue), select-all toggles both to sky-styled, count label '(2 selected)' shows. Cascade works: sizes-empty disappears after selecting colors, size chips appear, whole-product-toggle defaults CHECKED, unchecking + clicking size-chip flips it to false. Summary stats live-update. Pause button queues 1 job (Blue has no style_ids in seed so only Black job created — this is expected seed behavior, backend correctly skips colors with 0 style_ids). Idempotency verified: 2nd pause click returned already_queued, history count stayed at 1. history-item expand shows 'Waiting for scraper…' (correct — no EC2 worker in preview). Cleaned up pause_skus jobs via pymongo.
action_items: Optional: seed data for Blue color has no pm_skus rows so only 1 job is queued when both colors selected. If richer multi-color validation is wanted, seed a pm_skus row for the Blue product so a real 2-job multi-select flow can be demonstrated.
For real E2E validation of pause_skus, the EC2 Playwright worker (pause_skus_fetcher.py) needs to run on user's EC2 — not applicable to preview env.
critical_code_review_comments: InventoryActionsPage.js is ~650 lines including HistoryRow subcomponent — consider extracting HistoryRow to its own file for maintainability.
doPause loops sequentially awaiting each api.post — for many colors this is slow; could use Promise.all with per-color error tracking.

Router prefix is /inventory-actions but the wildcard route @router.get('/{job_id}') is declared AFTER /history so ordering is OK, but adding an explicit route pattern (e.g. constrain to 24-hex) would be safer against ambiguity.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Cleaned up pause_skus jobs from db.jobs after testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bulk Pause page at /inventory-actions is fully wired and both prior UI bugs are resolved. Seed has 2 accounts, category 'Vertis', colors Black+Blue. Only Black currently has a Style ID (SKU1) in pm_skus so a multi-color pause with both selected still queues just 1 job — this is a seed limitation, not a bug. Backend pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_inventory_actions.py = 5/5 passing.
rca of the issue: N/A — all reported bugs fixed and verified.
